notes.title: Global update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006343/eda41cc993ad7c38cd4a3b2f586afa3f128c9c68.png[/img]

Fight along with your friend or a random person in an intellectual bloody duel!

[olist]
[*] The update adds a new game mode - multiplayer. Online mode is available in two versions:
[list]
[*] Random game - the server will automatically select a player for you.
[*] Game by access code - enter a special code that your opponent will generate to join him in the session.
[/list]
[*] Added volume control in single player.
[*] Added a game menu with the ability to select different characters for online play.
[*] Improved graphics in single player.
[*] Fixed some bugs.
[/olist]

Good game!

notes.title: Coming update - new game mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006343/32e0772aafa52b0617c8fd438fb5ecdc6c796b8d.gif[/img]

Hello everyone!

We are pleased to inform you that we will be adding multiplayer to the game in the near future! We are now actively working on it. We wrote the main code, drew graphics, added effects. At the moment, the multiplayer is at the testing stage and bug fixes.
The game will be played in a 1 vs 1 format. On the day of the multiplayer release, owners of the base game will receive a free update.

P.S. The game is being developed on an old engine, and we may not be able to fix some bugs, so don't beat us..
